subject: Competitive bake-off recap + next steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nexacare.com>, Jo Chen <jo.chen@nexacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Redwood vs Orion & Helix bake-off (today's call)

Hi Samir / Jo —

Thanks again for taking time today to walk through NexaCare's evaluation. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we all stay aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you reiterated:
- High inference tail latency during peak reporting windows (~150k reqs/day).
- Unpredictable token cost across different vendors when scaling to multi-region.
- Need for private deployment (VPC) and strict data residency controls for PHI.
- Evaluation must include model quality parity for clinical summarization flows.

Decision criteria (what you said matters most):
- 99th percentile latency under 450ms (on your benchmark workload)
- End-to-end cost per 1M tokens at targeted throughput
- Private deployment with customer-managed keys and audit logs
- Ease of rollout (canary, A/B) and rollback behavior
- Clear quant metrics + sample prompt set for quality checks

Competitive landscape from today's discussion:
- OrionHealth: strong at throughput but unclear on private deployment SLAs; pricing quoted high for reserved capacity.
- HelixAI: good developer ergonomics, mixed results on long-context summarization.
- Redwood (us): focus on predictable economics (batching, caching profiles), unified runtime across hosted/dedicated/private.

Agreed bake-off plan (attached workbook has timeline/tests):
1) Redwood runs three benchmark tests against your sample workload: latency SLO test, cost-per-token projection at 10k RPS target, and a quality check on 100 sample clinical notes.
2) We will provide a reproducible test harness (Docker + scripts) and a one-day remote session with Rishi to help run the tests in your environment (or we can run in a controlled environment if you prefer).
3) NexaCare to share the sanitized prompt set and a short list of production traffic characteristics (seq length distribution, peak windows).
4) Target: complete bake-off and review results by Jul 24.

Open questions we noted:
- Will NexaCare require full on-prem (air-gapped) or is VPC with customer KMS sufficient?
- Any compliance evidence you need (SOC2 type II reports, penetration test scope)?
- Which metric should be primary (latency vs cost vs quality) if we have tradeoffs?

Next steps / asks:
- Samir: share sanitized prompt set + representative traffic CSV by end of day Tue (Jul 21).
- Jo: confirm whether VPC + BYOK is acceptable or whether on-prem is required.
- Rishi: I'll assign you to schedule a 90-min test run with NexaCare engineers (block for Wed/Thu).

Attachments: redwood-bakeoff-plan.xlsx (workbook with test matrix), redwood-performance-summary.pdf (example report), redline-terms.docx (initial SOW highlights)

Thanks — looking forward to running the tests.

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Redwood vs Orion & Helix bake-off (today's call)

Thanks Aditya — this is great, appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Prompt set: I'm attaching a sanitized sample (we'll provide full set by EOD Tue). We removed PHI but preserved length/profile.
2) On deployment: VPC + BYOK is acceptable for now; we are only considering on-prem if VPC can't meet audit requirements. Please include what logs/retention options you provide for audits.
3) Primary metric: latency is top priority for our triage pipelines, but cost becomes a tiebreaker if performance is similar.

Couple of asks:
- Can Rishi provide an example of the test harness (Dockerfile + run script) so our infra team can review before the session?
- Also please confirm pricing assumptions you will use for cost projections (reserved vs on-demand).

We'll aim to have the full prompt set + traffic CSV by EOD Tue (Jul 21). If we make that, is a Wed (22nd) test slot realistic?

Best,
Samir
Director, Infrastructure & AI Platforms
NexaCare
